scenarios.name: Children playing basketball
scenarios.line: Two children are playing on the crosswalk ahead, in the camera car's lane.

scenarios.name: Ambulance and stretcher
scenarios.line: An ambulance is stopped in the camera car's lane ahead and two paramedics on foot move a stretcher behind it.

scenarios.name: Taxi door
scenarios.line: A man on foot stands in the road beside the driver's door of a taxi parked on the right of the camera car's lane.

V2.control: The two children stay on the crosswalk and throw one basketball back and forth to each other, and the camera car brakes and stops just short of them.
Two paramedics wheel an empty stretcher from the ambulance's rear doors to the right-hand sidewalk.
The man pulls the driver's door of the taxi open toward the camera car's lane, and the door visibly swings open.
